headline: House resolution to censure Rep. Ilhan Omar and remove her from two committees was tabled and did not pass.
what_it_does: The resolution would have formally censured Representative Ilhan Omar of Minnesota, which is an official statement of disapproval by the House. It would also have removed her from the House Committee on Education and Workforce and the House Committee on the Budget. The official summary does not give the reasons for the censure. On September 17, 2025, the House voted to table it or send it back to committee, so it did not take effect.

who_it_affects.how: She would have been formally censured and lost her seats on the Education and Workforce and Budget committees.
Their representative would no longer have served on those two committees.
